_comment: Deploy with: gcloud firestore indexes composite create --collection-group=anbu --field-config=field-path=pk,order=ascending --field-config=field-path=sk,order=ascending

indexes._why: Single-table PK/SK layout: every read is an equality on pk plus a range scan on sk, ordered. Firestore needs a composite index for that combination. Without it, loading a case's receipt chain fails at query time rather than returning empty.
